answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to a cryptoeconomic proof-of-stake mechanism structured like a digital garden. In this paradigm, spawning a new agent requires locking a specific token stake that scales upward along an exponential spiral with each concurrent identity deployed by the same principal. Attackers attempting to flood the network with fake nodes face rapidly compounding capital lockups and diminishing returns, rendering the extraction of network nectar economically unviable.
